name: build
vm_prebuild_cloudinit_extra_cmds: install -d -m 0755 /etc/apt/keyrings && curl -fsSL --retry 5 --retry-all-errors --retry-delay 10 https://cli.github.com/packages/githubcli-archive-keyring.gpg -o /etc/apt/keyrings/githubcli-archive-keyring.gpg && echo "deb [arch=$(dpkg --print-architecture) signed-by=/etc/apt/keyrings/githubcli-archive-keyring.gpg] https://cli.github.com/packages stable main" > /etc/apt/sources.list.d/github-cli.list && apt-get update
DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y docker.io docker-buildx docker-compose-v2 git git-lfs gh zstd zip unzip build-essential python-is-python3 python3-pip python3-venv

su - ubuntu -c 'v=@RUNNER_VERSION@; a=$(dpkg --print-architecture | sed s/amd64/x64/); mkdir -p actions-runner-$v && curl -fsSL --retry 5 --retry-all-errors --retry-delay 10 https://github.com/actions/runner/releases/download/v$v/actions-runner-linux-$a-$v.tar.gz | tar -xz -C actions-runner-$v'
DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get purge -y --auto-remove snapd modemmanager udisks2 multipath-tools open-iscsi unattended-upgrades
systemctl mask apt-daily.timer apt-daily-upgrade.timer motd-news.timer update-notifier-download.timer fwupd-refresh.timer
